helpMenu.title: How GeoPS works
helpMenu.step1: Pick your district or share your location and see deals a few minutes away.
helpMenu.step2: Reserve without paying: you get a code.
helpMenu.step3: Show the code at the store and pay there.

registerPage.title: Create your account
registerPage.intro: We show you the valid offers around you, sorted by distance.

emailTaken.title: An account with this email already exists
emailTaken.description: If it is yours, log in. For security we do not show data of that account.
emailTaken.field: Use another email or log in.

phoneTaken.title: An account with this mobile already exists
phoneTaken.description: If it is yours, log in. For security we do not show data of that account.
phoneTaken.field: Use another mobile or log in.

loginPage.title: Log in
loginPage.intro: Use the email you registered with.
loginPage.brandTitle: Offers that are honored, a few minutes away
loginPage.brandText: Search by distance, reserve without paying in advance and pay at the store. If you own a business, log in here too and you land on your campaign panel.

registered.title: Your account is ready
registered.description: Log in with the email and password you just registered.

loginPage.expired: Your session ended. Log in again.

credentials.title: Wrong email or password
credentials.description: We do not say which one failed to protect your account.
credentials.field: Check the email and password and try again.

errors.generic: We could not log you in

business.typeHint: For example: Food · Lunch menus, Grocery, Beauty.

location.mapHint: Tap the map or drag the marker to your store's door.

empty.description: You can widen the distance or choose another district.

OFFER_NOT_AVAILABLE.description: It expired or the business withdrew it a moment ago. You were not charged.

promise.description: If you arrive in time and it is not honored, report it from your reservation.

existing.description: This is the same reservation; no new one was created.

REDEEMED.description: The business already validated this code.

EXPIRED.description: You were not charged: with GeoPS you only pay at the store.

REPORTED.description: You reported that the business did not honor the offer.

step3.title: Pay the price of the offer

businessSummary.subtitle: How your campaigns are doing on GeoPS

validatePage.title: Validate reservation code
validatePage.hint: Ask the customer for the code before charging.
validatePage.charge: Charge the deal price. The customer paid nothing when reserving.

MALFORMED.title: That code has the wrong format
MALFORMED.description: Codes have 8 letters and digits, without 0, O, 1, I or L.

NOT_FOUND.title: We could not find that code
NOT_FOUND.description: Check the spelling. Codes of other businesses do not show here.

OTHER_BUSINESS.title: This reservation is not for your business

REPORTED.title: This reservation has an open report
REPORTED.description: Check it in Reports before charging.

NETWORK.title: We could not validate the code
NETWORK.description: Check your connection and try again.

how.title: How to validate
how.step1: The customer shows you an 8 character code.
how.step2: Type it here and press Validate.
how.step3: If it is valid, charge the deal price at the counter.

reportsPage.title: Customer reports
reportsPage.emptyDescription: If a customer says a deal was not honored, you will see it here with the time to answer.

commentsPage.title: Customer comments
